methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a research-based, global pharmaceutical company. We discover, develop, manufacture and market leading prescription medicines for humans and animals' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for us around the world. Upon the expiration or loss of patent protection for one of our products ... we can lose the major portion of sales of that product in a very short period' (Item 1A); Lipitor's U.S. basic product patent 'expires in March 2010', the enantiomer patent 'expires in June 2011' (both including the pediatric exclusivity period); 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'

BEAR.desc: EPS -28.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-3.8%/yr (FY09 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.4-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +-3.8%/yr (FY04-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +7.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PFE (retrospective, 2009-06-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.44x (38.0% downside to Bear $9 / +86.1% upside to Bull $27) | Adj composite 2.30 vs market 1.70: gap +0.60 [UNDERVALUED] | -24% above the EPP floor $19 (15x FY09E $1.27) | Conservative 2-yr case: +84.8% total (+42.4%/yr) | At 11.4x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $19 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues -9.8% in Q1 2009, forward revenues -8.9% to -4.8% (FY09 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
